test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

“Why is he crying?” he asked.

options.text: He asked why he was crying.
She asked why he is crying.
She asked why he was crying.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Direct Speech:** “Why is he crying?” he asked.
 
• **Indirect Speech:** He asked why he was crying.
 
• The tense changes from **“is crying”** (present continuous) to **“was crying”** (past continuous) as per the rules of tense conversion in reported speech.
 
• The question word **"why"** remains unchanged in the indirect speech.
 
• The sentence is correctly structured without the need for additional conjunctions.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *He asked why he was crying.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2:** "She asked why he is crying." - Incorrect because the subject "he" should be in past tense.
 
• **Option 3:** "She asked why he was crying." - Incorrect because the reporting verb is "he asked," not "she asked."
 
• **Option 4:** "He asked why she crying." - Incorrect due to missing verb "was."
